mapper.select: WITH ranked_arrivals AS ( SELECT apo.id AS "arrivalPredictionId", vro.id AS "vehicleRunObservationId", vro.provider_vehicle_id AS "providerVehicleId", vro.service_type AS "serviceType", apo.alighting_stop_status AS "alightingStopStatus", vro.line_id AS "lineId", apo.boarding_stop_id AS "boardingStopId", apo.expected_at AS "expectedAt", apo.min_expected_at AS "minExpectedAt", apo.max_expected_at AS "maxExpectedAt", apo.remaining_stops AS "remainingStops", apo.source AS "source", apo.confidence AS "confidence", vro.movement_status AS "movementStatus", vro.current_stop_id AS "currentStopId", current_stop.public_name AS "currentStopName", destination_stop.public_name AS "destinationStopName", vro.current_sequence AS "currentSequence", vro.latitude AS "latitude", vro.longitude AS "longitude", apo.observed_at AS "observedAt", apo.received_at AS "receivedAt", ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY vro.provider_vehicle_id ORDER BY apo.observed_at DESC, apo.received_at DESC, apo.id DESC ) AS "rowNumber" FROM arrival_prediction_observation apo INNER JOIN vehicle_run_observation vro ON vro.id = apo.vehicle_run_observation_id INNER JOIN transit_line tl ON tl.id = vro.line_id INNER JOIN transit_provider tp ON tp.id = tl.provider_id INNER JOIN stop_pattern_stop boarding_sps ON boarding_sps.stop_pattern_id = vro.stop_pattern_id AND boarding_sps.stop_id = apo.boarding_stop_id AND boarding_sps.pickup_allowed = TRUE LEFT JOIN transit_stop current_stop ON current_stop.id = vro.current_stop_id LEFT JOIN transit_stop destination_stop ON destination_stop.id = vro.destination_stop_id WHERE vro.line_id = #{lineId} AND vro.direction_id = #{directionId} AND apo.boarding_stop_id = #{boardingStopId} AND apo.expected_at >= CASE WHEN tp.transport_type = 'SUBWAY' THEN CAST(#{observedAfter} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) ELSE CAST(#{asOf} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) END AND apo.observed_at >= #{observedAfter} ) SELECT "arrivalPredictionId", "vehicleRunObservationId", "providerVehicleId", "serviceType", "alightingStopStatus", "lineId", "boardingStopId", "expectedAt", "minExpectedAt", "maxExpectedAt", "remainingStops", "source", "confidence", "movementStatus", "currentStopId", "currentStopName", "destinationStopName", "currentSequence", "latitude", "longitude", "observedAt", "receivedAt" FROM ranked_arrivals WHERE "rowNumber" = 1 ORDER BY "expectedAt" ASC, "providerVehicleId" ASC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH ranked_arrivals AS ( SELECT apo.id AS "arrivalPredictionId", vro.id AS "vehicleRunObservationId", vro.provider_vehicle_id AS "providerVehicleId", vro.service_type AS "serviceType", apo.alighting_stop_status AS "alightingStopStatus", vro.line_id AS "lineId", apo.boarding_stop_id AS "boardingStopId", apo.expected_at AS "expectedAt", apo.min_expected_at AS "minExpectedAt", apo.max_expected_at AS "maxExpectedAt", apo.remaining_stops AS "remainingStops", apo.source AS "source", apo.confidence AS "confidence", vro.movement_status AS "movementStatus", vro.current_stop_id AS "currentStopId", current_stop.public_name AS "currentStopName", destination_stop.public_name AS "destinationStopName", vro.current_sequence AS "currentSequence", vro.latitude AS "latitude", vro.longitude AS "longitude", apo.observed_at AS "observedAt", apo.received_at AS "receivedAt", ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY vro.provider_vehicle_id ORDER BY apo.observed_at DESC, apo.received_at DESC, apo.id DESC ) AS "rowNumber" FROM arrival_prediction_observation apo INNER JOIN vehicle_run_observation vro ON vro.id = apo.vehicle_run_observation_id INNER JOIN transit_line tl ON tl.id = vro.line_id INNER JOIN transit_provider tp ON tp.id = tl.provider_id INNER JOIN stop_pattern_stop boarding_sps ON boarding_sps.stop_pattern_id = vro.stop_pattern_id AND boarding_sps.stop_id = apo.boarding_stop_id AND boarding_sps.pickup_allowed = TRUE LEFT JOIN transit_stop current_stop ON current_stop.id = vro.current_stop_id LEFT JOIN transit_stop destination_stop ON destination_stop.id = vro.destination_stop_id INNER JOIN stop_pattern_stop alighting_sps ON alighting_sps.stop_pattern_id = vro.stop_pattern_id AND alighting_sps.stop_id = #{alightingStopId} AND alighting_sps.dropoff_allowed = TRUE AND alighting_sps.stop_sequence > boarding_sps.stop_sequence WHERE vro.line_id = #{lineId} AND apo.boarding_stop_id = #{boardingStopId} AND apo.expected_at >= CASE WHEN tp.transport_type = 'SUBWAY' THEN CAST(#{observedAfter} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) ELSE CAST(#{asOf} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) END AND apo.observed_at >= #{observedAfter} AND ( apo.requested_alighting_stop_id IS NULL OR apo.requested_alighting_stop_id = #{alightingStopId} ) AND apo.alighting_stop_status = 'STOPS' ) SELECT "arrivalPredictionId", "vehicleRunObservationId", "providerVehicleId", "serviceType", "alightingStopStatus", "lineId", "boardingStopId", "expectedAt", "minExpectedAt", "maxExpectedAt", "remainingStops", "source", "confidence", "movementStatus", "currentStopId", "currentStopName", "destinationStopName", "currentSequence", "latitude", "longitude", "observedAt", "receivedAt" FROM ranked_arrivals WHERE "rowNumber" = 1 ORDER BY "expectedAt" ASC, "providerVehicleId" ASC LIMIT #{limit}
